test_map_batches_returns_scalar: test map_batches with returns_scalar=True to reduce a column to a scalar value per group
test_map_batches_group_by_agg: test map_batches with group_by and agg to apply a function returning a specified return_dtype
test_lazyframe_map_batches_schema: test LazyFrame.map_batches to apply a function across the entire dataframe with schema validation
test_ufunc_args_map_batches: test map_batches with numpy ufunc arguments to apply element-wise operations across columns
test_map_batches_no_return_dtype: test map_batches with return_dtype=None to infer output dtype from literal expressions
